description: Test script for the BudgetManager module in the litellm project, containing test cases for budget creation, checking, updating, and reset logic, as well as calling the completion function.

classes.name: BudgetManager
classes.description: Class responsible for managing user budgets, including creation, updates, reset, and data storage.

methods.name: create_budget
methods.description: Creates a new budget for a user with specified total, duration, and project details.

methods.name: get_current_cost
methods.description: Returns the current accumulated cost for a user.

methods.name: get_total_budget
methods.description: Retrieves the total budget allocated for a user.

methods.name: update_cost
methods.description: Updates the user's budget based on usage, possibly including completion object details.

methods.name: save_data
methods.description: Saves the current budget data, possibly to persistent storage.

methods.name: get_users
methods.description: Returns the list of users with budgets.

methods.name: update_budget_all_users
methods.description: Resets or updates budgets for all users based on the elapsed duration.
